met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Gulf of Mannar & adjoining south Tamil Nadu coast at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from the cyclonic circulation over Gulf of Mannar & adjoining south Tamil Nadu to North Madhya Maharashtra now runs from the above cyclonic circulation over Gulf of Mannar & adjoining south Tamil Nadu to North Interior Karnataka across interior Tamil Nadu and interior Karnataka at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The trough from Northwest Rajasthan to Southeast Madhya Pradesh at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over South Bangladesh & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Haryana & neighbourhoodat 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance over Himachal Pradesh at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Strait of Malacca extending upto 9.4 km above mean sea level persists. it is likely to emerge in Andaman Sea around 11th October. Under its influence, a low-pressure area is likely to form over the Southeast Bay of Bengal around 13th October.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central parts of Odisha at 0.9 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
